title: The twisted affine-line source and its explicit bounded etale origin
statement: Use the finite coefficient quotient $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^{n+1}$ for $n\geq0$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-pur-conventions]. Let $Y$ be a scheme, $X=\mathbf A^1_Y$ with projection $p$ [def-sbc-affine-space], and $j:X\to\mathbf P^1_Y$ the standard $D_+(T_1)$ chart [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change]. Choose $r\geq0$ with $\ell^{r+1}A=0$. Let $B_T$ be the existing ordinary finite roots-of-unity Tate line [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback], and $C_T$ exact comparison. Define $F=C_Xj_e^*B_{\mathbf P^1_Y}[2]$. When ell is invertible on the projective line and on X, retain its canonical isomorphism to the specified inverse-limit pro-etale coefficient $A_X(1)[2]$ [def-coefficient-twists-detailed, lem-pur-vector-integration-site-comparison], using the canonical operations [def-pur-affine-line-purity-coordinate-maps]. For an actual pro-etale complex $K$, an ordinary bounded constructible finite-Tor complex $K^e$, and $e_K:C_YK^e\cong K$ (the representatives of [det-pe-finite-tor-comparison-noetherian]), define $M_K=Lp^*K\otimes_A^LF$ and $M_K^e=p_e^*K^e\otimes_A^Lj_e^*B_{\mathbf P^1_Y}[2]$, with derived operations [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. Retain the canonical isomorphism $C_XM_K^e\cong M_K$ obtained by canonical tensor/inverse-image comparison followed by $Lp^*e_K$. The ordinary complex is bounded below, since inverse image is exact and the finite-Tor-amplitude bound of $K^e$ bounds its tensor with a sheaf shifted by two. Exact comparison transfers this lower bound to $M_K$. Define the bounded-below etale-origin witness required by [thm-sf-ambient-adjoint-class] to be exactly this ordinary complex and canonical isomorphism, with these lower-bound proofs. No mere existence choice supplies its data. Retain also the five defining coordinate equalities for F, its ordinary coefficient, M_K and M_K^e; equality transports of these identities are used in the canonical composites. The prescribed twists are [def-coefficient-twists-detailed], and the normalized comparison is [lem-pur-vector-integration-site-comparison].

reviewed_lean.note: First stage-2 delivery (commit c19b0049: 3 modules, 2 new def nodes; the coordinate-maps record is in the commit, not the snapshot). Clause by clause: Ring P = finiteTateCoefficient(level-1) with ringEquiv, the reindexing already used in SupportedBottomGluing/AffineTranslationTrace; Y separated finite type via aY, Noetherian derived; (j,q) = affineTraceLineCompactification (affineChart, ProjectiveLine projection); t^p = projectiveTrace, and ProjectiveCompatibility gives beta then t^p = C(t^e); integration = Rq_* of the actual openAdjunction counit after the inverse-image comparison, then the trace; Pi_K = inverse of s_Y, PF_c, Rp_!(s_X), the node's order; a_K = inverse projection, 1 tensor integration, canonical unit iso and native right unitor; gamma = specifiedExceptionalHomEquiv with target sfFiniteExceptionalAt, both recorded stmt_dep declarations; the witness is the displayed ordinary p_e^*K^e tensor j_e^*B_P[2] with its canonical comparison. M_K is in tau-coordinates C_X(j_e^*B_P[2]), which the node allows; coefficientTwistIso links it to A_X(1)[2]. Sorry'd coordinate equalities are true by unfold/rfl, so the eqToIso transports are identities. Boundedness, projection_isIso and primeUnit are true. Edge cases: Y empty, n=1, every exponent, K=0, universes unchanged. Statements verbatim (script check); only new def node added to item stmt_deps; no cycle; docstrings and both report sections present; no recompile since no file changed (worker reports 25.4/15.0/10.8 s clean). Advisories: owner nodes outside stmt_deps (finite-site-coordinates, tensor-projection, proetale-affine-line-counit, supported-projective-site-arrows); coefficientFinite duplicates vectorBundlePurityFiniteCoefficient; public priority-2000 coefficientRing instance; unused tensorTrace/moduleTensorTrace/source_eq/ringEquiv/coefficientTwistIso; primeUnit restates a private conventions lemma; independence of gamma from (Ke,eK) rests on thm-sf-ambient-adjoint-class.
